# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 14 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam Tells Seth of Paradise

---

**1** 'When God formed me from the dust of the earth and breathed life into me, he led me into paradise and showed me all its fruit trees.'

**2** 'God told me and Eve that we could eat freely from all the fruit trees — except one, in the middle of paradise: the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.'

**3** 'God commanded the angels to serve me and to worship me in God's sight.'

**4** 'At that command, all the angels worshiped me — except the devil. That is why he was cast from heaven, and why he turned his malice against me.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
